newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian 96/97 exports seen at $38 bln - minister.
newsitem.headline: Indian 96/97 exports seen at $38 bln - minister.

text.p: Indian exports in 1996/97 (April-March) are expected to rise to about $38 billion, Commerce Minister Bolla Buli Ramaiah said on Tuesday.
"We hope this year it (exports) will go up to $38 billion," Ramaiah told a conference on foreign investment in India.
Commerce Secretary Tejendra Khanna, the highest ranking civil servant in the ministry, told the conference India's two-way trade with other countries would total about $75 billion in 1996/97.
In 1995/96, imports and exports together totalled $68.2 billion, according to government figures.
